Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class AbstractDAO<T,ID>

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<T,ID>
Type Parameters:
T - The entity type managed by this DAO
ID - The type of the entity's primary key
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<T,ID>
Direct Known Subclasses:
EvaluationCycleDAOimpl, EvaluationDAOimpl, MessageDAOimpl, NotificationDAOimpl, PendingRegistrationDAOimpl, ResetPasswordDAOimpl, SessionDAOimpl, SettingsDAOimpl, TrainingAreaDAOimpl, TrainingDAOimpl, TrainingParticipationDAOimpl, TwoFactorAuthDAOimpl, UserDAOimpl, WorkPlaceDAOimpl
public abstract class AbstractDAO<T,ID> extends Object implements BasicDAO<T,ID>
Abstract base implementation of the BasicDAO interface.

This class provides a concrete implementation of the basic CRUD operations defined in BasicDAO using JPA/Hibernate. It serves as a foundation for all specific DAO implementations in the application, promoting code reuse and consistency across data access layers.

Key implementation features:

  • Uses JPA EntityManager for database operations
  • Implements type-safe operations through generics
  • Provides helper methods for common query patterns
  • Uses Criteria API for dynamic query building
  • Supports named queries for optimized performance

Subclasses must implement getEntityClass() to specify the entity type they manage. This enables type-safe operations and proper entity loading.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public T create(T entity)
      Creates a new entity in the data store.

      This method persists a new entity to the underlying data store. The entity will be assigned a unique identifier if it doesn't already have one.

      Implementation uses EntityManager.persist(Object) to make the entity instance managed and persistent. The entity will be inserted into the database when the transaction is committed or the persistence context is flushed.

      Specified by:
      create in interface BasicDAO<T,ID>
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity to create. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The created entity with its generated ID and any other auto-generated fields populated

    • update

      public T update(T entity)
      Updates an existing entity in the data store.

      This method merges the state of the given entity with the persistent state. The entity must have a valid identifier that corresponds to an existing record.

      Implementation uses EntityManager.merge(Object) to merge the state of the given entity into the current persistence context. If the entity exists in the database, it will be updated; otherwise, a new record will be created.

      Specified by:
      update in interface BasicDAO<T,ID>
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity to update. Must not be null and must have a valid ID.
      Returns:
      The updated entity, potentially with updated version fields or timestamps

    • findById

      public Optional<T> findById(ID id)
      Finds an entity by its unique identifier.

      This method performs a lookup for an entity with the specified ID. The operation is read-only and does not modify the entity state.

      Implementation uses EntityManager.find(Class, Object) to retrieve the entity by its primary key. This method loads the entity eagerly if found.

      Specified by:
      findById in interface BasicDAO<T,ID>
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the entity to find. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the entity if found, or Optional.empty() if not found

    • findAll

      public List<T> findAll()
      Retrieves all entities of this type from the data store.

      This method returns all entities managed by this DAO. Use with caution for large datasets as it may impact performance and memory usage. Consider using pagination methods in specific DAO implementations for large result sets.

      Implementation uses JPA Criteria API to build a type-safe query that selects all entities of the managed type. This approach provides compile-time safety and is database-agnostic.

      Specified by:
      findAll in interface BasicDAO<T,ID>
      Returns:
      A List containing all entities, or an empty list if no entities exist

    • deleteById

      public boolean deleteById(ID id)
      Deletes an entity by its unique identifier.

      This method removes the entity with the specified ID from the data store. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

      Implementation first attempts to find the entity by ID, then removes it if found. The removal is performed using EntityManager.remove(Object) which requires the entity to be in a managed state.

      Specified by:
      deleteById in interface BasicDAO<T,ID>
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the entity to delete. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if the entity was successfully deleted, false if no entity with the given ID was found
